notes.meaning: Haman was put to death as a traitor, so his property went to the crown. The king gave all of it to Esther to make up for the danger Haman had put her in. Esther now told the king that Mordecai was her relative who had raised her as an orphan. So Mordecai was welcomed at court as one of the king's top officials. Matthew Henry notes how humble Mordecai had been, never using his tie to the queen for his own gain.
